stdout:
# D14 at-rest control (agentops#2408): hourly client-side encrypted logical
# dumps of vuoro-postgres. Operator decision 2026-09-17: these dumps REPLACE the
# plaintext Barman backups (accepted trade-off: no PITR, RPO 1h). Barman keeps
# running for this cluster until a restore from these encrypted objects has
# been tested; its removal is a separate, later change. See
# docs/backups-cnpg.md "D14 fallback".
#
# Stream only: pg_dump -Fc | age | rclone rcat. Plaintext never touches a disk;
# pipefail fails the Job if any stage fails. Objects are encrypted to the
# "recovery" (offline custody) and "operator" recipients from
# docs/rebuild/security-authority.recipients.json, so a dump is recoverable
# outside this estate, and to its "pgdump-drill" data recipient, which only
# the daily restore drill in namespace cnpg-dump-drill holds.
#
# Every database the credential can connect to (except the CNPG "postgres"
# maintenance database) is dumped to its own object series,
# <cluster>-<db>-<UTC stamp>.dump.age. A database the role cannot read fails
# the Job loudly rather than being skipped.
#
# Retention (tiered, per series, only after that series' upload verified):
# every dump from the last 48h, then the earliest dump of each UTC day back to
# 30 days. About 48 + 29 = 77 objects per database instead of 720.
#
# Destination: Object-Lock bucket appservice-pgdump-locked (versioned, default
# COMPLIANCE retention 14 days, noncurrent versions expire after 1 day once
# unlocked). A prune here only adds a delete marker; the locked version stays
# 14 days, so a leaked writer key cannot erase recent dumps. docs/backups-cnpg.md.
#
# Credential: vuoro-postgres-app holds the database owner role (vuoro). The
# work/execution/knowledge/audit (and actionq_smoke) schemas are owned by the
# *_migration roles; vuoro is a member of all four with inherit, so it reads
# every schema. The *_runtime roles own nothing.
# Non-superuser; it owns the application objects, so it dumps the whole
# database.
#
# Network: a dedicated egress policy for this pod admits 443 (GitHub for the
# age release, Hetzner for the upload):
# system/networkpolicies/app/vuoro-shared-allow-egress-pgdump-age.yaml. DNS and
# in-namespace 5432 are already admitted by the namespace baseline.
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: cnpg-pgdump-age
  namespace: vuoro-shared
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: cnpg-pgdump-age
spec:
  # Hourly at :53. The clusters use distinct minutes (03 analytics,
  # 08 nextcloud, 13 authentik, 19 paperless, 23 vaultwarden, 29 immich,
  # 33 forgejo, 43 sprintctl, 53 vuoro-shared) so dumps do not overlap; the
  # cnpg-dump-drill restore runs daily at 04:46.
  schedule: "53 * * * *"
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 1
  failedJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  jobTemplate:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: cnpg-pgdump-age
    spec:
      backoffLimit: 0
      activeDeadlineSeconds: 3600
      template:
        metadata:
          labels:
            app.kubernetes.io/name: cnpg-pgdump-age
        spec:
          restartPolicy: Never
          automountServiceAccountToken: false
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
          initContainers:
            # age has no maintained upstream image: fetch the pinned release and
            # verify it against the sha256 digest GitHub publishes for the asset.
            # Bumping AGE_VERSION requires updating AGE_SHA256 in the same change.
            - name: fetch-age
              # renovate: datasource=docker depName=curlimages/curl
              image: curlimages/curl:8.13.0@sha256:e6ebb770fb6e2236c2e83ad6b6dbbd32cb6dff0b17a9482a7d4bca20f1c9b50a
              command: ["/bin/sh", "-c"]
              args:
                - |
                  set -eu
                  cd /work
                  curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 -o age.tgz "https://github.com/FiloSottile/age/releases/download/v$AGE_VERSION/age-v$AGE_VERSION-linux-amd64.tar.gz"
                  echo "$AGE_SHA256  age.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
                  tar -xzf age.tgz age/age
                  install -m 0555 age/age /tools/age
                  rm -rf age age.tgz
              env:
                - name: AGE_VERSION
                  value: "1.3.2"
                - name: AGE_SHA256
                  value: cbe24006683f8eb669266162894b9a522a1af52f2665fbc63a4bb032ed26ac10
              securityContext:
                allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
                capabilities:
                  drop: ["ALL"]
                readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
                runAsNonRoot: true
                runAsUser: 65534
                runAsGroup: 65534
              resources:
                requests:
                  cpu: 10m
                  memory: 32Mi
                limits:
                  cpu: 200m
                  memory: 128Mi
              volumeMounts:
                - name: tools
                  mountPath: /tools
                - name: tmp
                  mountPath: /work
            - name: copy-rclone
              # renovate: datasource=docker depName=rclone/rclone
              image: rclone/rclone:1.75.1@sha256:45401ad7410db1d67ffdb58e19059ad20b0d8e0285a60e38bbec55cc1019c7a5
              command: ["/bin/sh", "-c"]
              args:
                - install -m 0555 /usr/local/bin/rclone /tools/rclone
              securityContext:
                allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
                capabilities:
                  drop: ["ALL"]
                readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
                runAsNonRoot: true
                runAsUser: 65534
                runAsGroup: 65534
              resources:
                requests:
                  cpu: 10m
                  memory: 32Mi
                limits:
                  cpu: 200m
                  memory: 128Mi
              volumeMounts:
                - name: tools
                  mountPath: /tools
          containers:
            - name: dump
              # pg_dump must be >= the server major; every Barman-backed CNPG server
              # in this estate is 16.13-16.15.
              image: ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/postgresql:16.15@sha256:34cd4159d07b3410a1b29da35072e2e927a0905e717a61afa3814624a2e8859a
              command: ["/bin/bash", "-c"]
              args:
                - |
                  set -euo pipefail

                  prefix="hetzner:$BUCKET/backups/pgdump-age/$NAMESPACE/$CLUSTER"

                  # Retention for one object series (<series>-<UTC stamp>.dump.age):
                  # keep every dump from the last 48h, then the earliest dump of
                  # each UTC day back to 30 days, delete the rest. Stamps are
                  # fixed-width UTC, so string order is time order.
                  prune() {
                    series="$1"
                    recent="$(date -u -d '48 hours ago' +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
                    expire="$(date -u -d '30 days ago' +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
                    /tools/rclone lsf --files-only --include "$series-*.dump.age" "$prefix/" \
                      | LC_ALL=C sort \
                      | awk -v series="$series" -v recent="$recent" -v expire="$expire" '
                          # Exact series only: "<series>-" + 16-char stamp + ".dump.age".
                          length($0) != length(series) + 26 || index($0, series "-") != 1 { next }
                          { stamp = substr($0, length(series) + 2, 16); day = substr(stamp, 1, 8) }
                          stamp < expire { print; next }
                          stamp >= recent { next }
                          day in kept { print; next }
                          { kept[day] = 1 }
                        ' > /tmp/prune.txt
                    if [ -s /tmp/prune.txt ]; then
                      echo "pruning $(wc -l < /tmp/prune.txt) object(s) of $series"
                      /tools/rclone delete --files-from-raw /tmp/prune.txt "$prefix/"
                    fi
                  }

                  databases="$(psql --no-password -AtX -c "SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datallowconn AND NOT datistemplate AND datname <> 'postgres' ORDER BY datname")"
                  if [ -z "$databases" ]; then
                    echo "no application databases visible to $PGUSER; failing"
                    exit 1
                  fi
                  echo "databases: $(echo $databases)"

                  for db in $databases; do
                    stamp="$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
                    object="$CLUSTER-$db-$stamp.dump.age"

                    # Up to 3 attempts: a single object-store 5xx (Hetzner 504 on
                    # PutObject, 2026-09-27) otherwise fails the whole hourly run.
                    # A retry re-dumps, so the object is always a complete dump.
                    attempt=1
                    echo "dumping $db from $PGHOST to $prefix/$object"
                    until pg_dump --format=custom --no-password --dbname="$db" \
                      | /tools/age -r "$AGE_RECIPIENT_RECOVERY" -r "$AGE_RECIPIENT_OPERATOR" -r "$AGE_RECIPIENT_DRILL" \
                      | /tools/rclone rcat --s3-chunk-size 16M --s3-upload-concurrency 1 "$prefix/$object"; do
                      if [ "$attempt" -ge 3 ]; then
                        echo "dump of $db failed after $attempt attempts; failing"
                        exit 1
                      fi
                      echo "attempt $attempt for $db failed; retrying in $((attempt * 30))s"
                      sleep $((attempt * 30))
                      attempt=$((attempt + 1))
                    done

                    # An empty database encrypts to ~1.1 KiB; anything under 512
                    # bytes means the pipeline produced no real dump.
                    size="$(/tools/rclone size --json "$prefix/$object" | sed -n 's/.*"bytes":\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p')"
                    echo "uploaded $object ($size bytes)"
                    if [ -z "$size" ] || [ "$size" -lt 512 ]; then
                      echo "uploaded object is missing or implausibly small; failing"
                      exit 1
                    fi

                    prune "$CLUSTER-$db"
                  done

                  # Series written before per-database naming (<cluster>-<stamp>).
                  prune "$CLUSTER"
                  /tools/rclone lsl "$prefix/"
              env:
                - name: NAMESPACE
                  value: vuoro-shared
                - name: CLUSTER
                  value: vuoro-postgres
                - name: BUCKET
                  # Literal, like the etcd Object-Lock bucket: not a secret.
                  value: appservice-pgdump-locked
                - name: PGHOST
                  value: vuoro-postgres-rw
                - name: PGPORT
                  value: "5432"
                # Connection database for the pg_database listing; every listed
                # database is then dumped.
                - name: PGDATABASE
                  value: vuoro
                - name: PGUSER
                  valueFrom:
                    secretKeyRef:
                      name: vuoro-postgres-app
                      key: username
                - name: PGPASSWORD
                  valueFrom:
                    secretKeyRef:
                      name: vuoro-postgres-app
                      key: password
                - name: PGSSLMODE
                  value: verify-full
                - name: PGSSLROOTCERT
                  value: /pgca/ca.crt
                # Public keys ("recovery", "operator") from
                # docs/rebuild/security-authority.recipients.json.
                - name: AGE_RECIPIENT_RECOVERY
                  value: age1secuwmnjmyke02d9zvfdgxstrknmxdcaw0l4vd2mp2fx8l2cqv8s9ux522
                - name: AGE_RECIPIENT_OPERATOR
                  value: age13dx7hmvvs4rdwz024shq8xhpgjyxnpwvrrz5k87g8z8czc27vfzqdrf78l
                # In-cluster restore drill only (cnpg-dump-drill); see dataRecipients.
                - name: AGE_RECIPIENT_DRILL
                  value: age1mqha36dd33yknuptag8mgskt9sjxd482rdnmgslyhxwy0e2pmycsx5en5g
                - name: HOME
                  value: /tmp
                - name: RCLONE_CONFIG
                  value: /notfound  # rclone: in-memory config, no "config file not found" notice
                - name: RCLONE_CONFIG_HETZNER_TYPE
                  value: s3
                - name: RCLONE_CONFIG_HETZNER_PROVIDER
                  value: Other
                - name: RCLONE_CONFIG_HETZNER_ENDPOINT
                  value: https://${HETZNER_S3_BUCKET_ENDPOINT}
                - name: RCLONE_CONFIG_HETZNER_REGION
                  value: hel1
                - name: RCLONE_CONFIG_HETZNER_NO_CHECK_BUCKET
                  value: "true"
                # Shared cluster Hetzner key for now; a dedicated key scoped to
                # this prefix is a follow-up (D5-style credential).
                - name: RCLONE_CONFIG_HETZNER_ACCESS_KEY_ID
                  valueFrom:
                    secretKeyRef:
                      name: vuoro-shared-cnpg-backup-s3
                      key: ACCESS_KEY_ID
                - name: RCLONE_CONFIG_HETZNER_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
                  valueFrom:
                    secretKeyRef:
                      name: vuoro-shared-cnpg-backup-s3
                      key: SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
              securityContext:
                allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
                capabilities:
                  drop: ["ALL"]
                readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
                runAsNonRoot: true
                runAsUser: 26
                runAsGroup: 26
              resources:
                requests:
                  cpu: 50m
                  memory: 128Mi
                limits:
                  cpu: "1"
                  memory: 512Mi
              volumeMounts:
                - name: tools
                  mountPath: /tools
                  readOnly: true
                - name: tmp
                  mountPath: /tmp
                - name: pg-ca
                  mountPath: /pgca
                  readOnly: true
          volumes:
            - name: tools
              emptyDir:
                sizeLimit: 256Mi
            - name: tmp
              emptyDir:
                sizeLimit: 64Mi
            - name: pg-ca
              secret:
                secretName: vuoro-postgres-ca
                items:
                  - key: ca.crt
                    path: ca.crt
